topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the introductory framing, practical context, and learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Tumor virology, proto-oncogenes, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the historical discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes through tumor viruses and detail the laboratory assays used to evaluate cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification of cancer mutations and tumor suppressor mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer mutations are classified and demonstrate the functional mechanics of tumor suppressor pathways and mutant allele dosage.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the molecular sources, DNA repair defects, and cellular consequences of sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step progression, hereditary cancer syndromes, and tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sequential mutation acquisition, inherited cancer predispositions, and selective pressures govern tumor development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture with concluding remarks, reading recommendations, and a preview of the next session.
